desc: Default stroke weight for 24px icons. Matches Boozt's Suisse Int'l visual weight.
Medium stroke for 32px icons. Proportionally scaled to maintain optical consistency.
Bold stroke for 48px icons. Touch-target-sized icons get heavier strokes for readability.
Heavy stroke for display icons. 96px illustrations, brand marks, hero-level icon art.
Sharp corners. Full-bleed images, tables, dividers, elements that intentionally feel hard-edged.
Subtle rounding. Input fields, buttons, tags, badges, small interactive elements.
Standard rounding. Cards, dropdowns, modals, toast notifications, image containers.
Generous rounding. Feature cards, hero image frames, promotional blocks, large interactive surfaces.
Bold rounding. Floating action areas, bottom sheets, prominent UI panels.
Pill / circle. Avatar circles, pill-shaped buttons, status indicators, round badges, toggle thumbs.
Brand typefaces. Suisse Int'l = Boozt's Swiss-style neo-grotesk (warm, refined).
Brand typefaces. ABC Favorit = ON's geometric sans (modern, energetic). Switched via semantic mode.

Fully transparent. Fade-out animations, invisible overlays, hidden states.
Ghost tint. Subtle hover backgrounds, disabled overlay on images, pressed ripple start.
Light overlay. Skeleton loading shimmer, soft scrim, disabled state overlay.
Visible tint. Active state backgrounds, selected row highlight, tooltip arrow background.
Half opacity. Modal backdrop, image overlay text protection, disabled element overlay.
Near-opaque. Heavy scrim behind modals, dark overlay on hero images for text legibility.
Fully opaque. Default state for all solid elements.
Thinnest visible stroke. Subtle card outlines, light dividers, decorative separators on retina screens.
Default border. Input field strokes, card borders, table cell dividers, button outlines.
Emphasized border. Active input focus ring, selected state outlines, hover border reinforcement.
Heavy border. Active tab indicators, selected card accent, strong visual anchors, focus-visible rings.
